newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends touch firmer, quiet.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends touch firmer, quiet.

text.p: Nearby London white sugar futures gave up much of their modest gains by the close after a day of thin trading.
December -- responsible for 193 lots of the paltry 425-lot total volume -- ended 50 cents higher at $316.70 per tonne after trading as high as $318.50.
Trade buying had offered earlier support, but volumes remained thin as Sugar Week comes to an end.
In Paris, December ended 10 cents easier at $316.50 and March 60 cents higher at $314.20.
